description: uBee Cover Review, portable edition. Review creator covers the way they post, with optional Drive, Spotify, Instagram and Pollen connectors set up by the user's Muse.
name: ubee-cover-review

scripts.build: npm --prefix client install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && node scripts/restore-brand.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/update-test.mjs && node scripts/render-test.mjs && node scripts/accounts-test.mjs && node scripts/remix-test.mjs && node scripts/compose-test.mjs && node scripts/smoke.mjs
